title.narrative: The Accountability & Capacity Building Initiative by Lesotho CSOs bringing together Police, CSOs & the Public for the realization of Human Rights compliance by the Lesotho Mounted Police Services

description.narrative: Sesotho Media has partnered with Gender-Links to implement an action that will address human rights violations perpetuated upon the police by members of the Lesotho Mounted Police Service. The project will further seek to increase awareness on the state of Lesotho Mounted Police Services in relation to Human Rights using the Assessment Report, Testimonial clips and the Documentary.
